title: HHHusher overview slider (v2)
description: On a bronze-tan band: a big four-line tagline whose lines rise in one after another, then a wide 5px-cornered picture card with a title at the top left and tabs along the bottom: the active one is an open yellow card (number, caps title, short text, read-more link), the others narrow cream-glass tiles. Clicking a tab crossfades the picture; the picture drifts inside its frame as you scroll.
notes: the band is the secondary colour; the card forces dark so its glass tabs read
one media slot per slide (picture or video), cropped like cover
needs JavaScript to switch slides (hydrate: visible); without it the first slide shows
